name: signage
description: Digital signage для локальной сети учреждения

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @signage/admin && npm run build -w @signage/player && npm run build -w @signage/server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @signage/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
